answer: Production deploys on Fridays have been completely prohibited, changing a previous policy where releases occurred on Friday afternoons. Under the active decision by Mei, no production deploys are allowed on Fridays, which includes scheduled jobs and configuration-only releases.

cited.quote: No production deploys on Fridays, including scheduled jobs and configuration-only releases.
The production release window is set to Friday afternoon, 14:00 to 16:00 Singapore time.
